limits: Largest absolute reversals are biased diagnostic examples, not a strength estimate.
Local timing and instrumentation can change completed search work; exact remote causation is not presumed.
A first divergence does not establish the cause of the eventual win or loss.
One-step counterfactuals fix the observed enemy command; they are not full-match interventions.
remote_access: Read-only ssh cat of completed results.jsonl and exactly four chosen gzip replays; no remote experiment or file creation.
revision_notes: Recorded numbers and original audit_script_sha256 are from the single successful instrumentation run. Afterwards only recorded-command/environment output metadata was added to the reproducer; no re-execution.
failed_setup_attempt: The first instrumentation setup rejected a nonunique timeout anchor from an unused revision helper. Its build TemporaryDirectory was removed. Restricting instrumentation to the first original evaluator allowed the one recorded run; no bot source was changed.

local_input_cleanup.scope: The completed row copy, four replay copies, selection and local audit scratch were removed after preserving this audit; canonical original artifacts are managed by the root agent.
